marketing_description: The Philips 573971 LED Filament Bulb is an energy-efficient replacement for 75W incandescent ST19 bulbs, offering 800 lumens of light while using only 8.8W of power. This dimmable bulb features a classic vintage design with a clear glass finish and has a medium E26 base. It is Title 20 Compliant and has a color rendering index of 90.
